senses.gloss: 1. मुच् cl. 1. Ā. मोचते, to cheat, Dhātup. vi, 12 (= √ मच्, q.v.)
मुच् [cf. Gk. μύσσω, μῦκος, μυκτής; Lat. mungo, mucus.]
3. मुच् mfn. freeing or delivering from (see अंहो-म्˚)
letting go or letting fall, dropping, discharging, shooting, sending (see जल-, पर्ण-, सायक-म्˚ &c.)
मुच् f. deliverance (see अ-मु॑च्).
मुच mf(ई)n. id. (see अ॑-मुची, नख-मुच, रश्मि-मुच).
मुचिर mfn. liberal, munificent, Uṇ., i, 52, Sch.
मुचिर m. charity, virtue, L.
wind, L.
a deity, L.
मुचक m. gum-lac, L.
मुचलिन्द v.l. for मुचिलिन्द, q.v.
मुचि m. N. of a Cakra-vartin, L.
मुचिलिन्द m. Pterospermum Suberifolium, L.
N. of a Nāga (who sheltered the Buddha from a violent storm by coiling himself round him), Lalit.; MWB. 39 &c.
of the sacred tree protected by this Nāga (under which B˚ seated himself), MWB. 232
of a Cakra-vartin, L.
of a mountain, Kāraṇḍ. (also -पर्वत, L.)
मुचिलिन्दा f. N. of a serpent-maid, Kāraṇḍ.
मुचुकुन्द m. Pterospermum Suberifolium, L.
N. of a Daitya, L.
of an ancient king (or Muni), MBh.; BhP.
of a son of Māndhātṛ (who assisted the gods in their wars with the demons and was rewarded by the boon of a long and unbroken sleep), MBh.; Pur.
of a son of Yadu, Hariv.
of the father of Candra-bhāga, Cat.
of a poet of Kāśmīra, ib.
मुचुकुन्द—कवि m. the poet Mucukunda, Bhojapr.
मुचुकुन्द—प्रसादक m. N. of Kṛṣṇa, Pañcar.
मुचुकुन्द—मोक्ष m. N. of wk.
मुचुकुन्द—स्तुति f. N. of wk.
मुचुटी f. a pair of forceps, Vāgbh.
(also ˚टि) a closed hand, fist, L.
snapping the fingers, L.
मुचुलिन्द m. a kind of big orange, L. (cf. मुचलिन्द and मुचिलिन्द).
मूचीप m. pl. N. of a people, ŚāṅkhŚr.
